history.prompt: Cinematic film still, 35mm anamorphic wide lens with dramatic depth of field. Extreme asymmetric composition. An imposing, unbranded heavy commercial freight truck idling in a vast logistics staging yard at blue hour dawn. The truck commands the right third of the frame, grounded on wet textured asphalt. A single strong practical amber floodlight rakes across the weathered corrugated steel of the trailer and the brushed metal grill, creating deep industrial contrast and crisp atmospheric depth. The left side of the frame is vast, empty editorial negative space in cool teal shadows. Restrained teal-and-amber palette, highly detailed, editorial cover standard.

history.alt_text: A modular mechanical assembly on concrete with three locked data modules and two visibly empty, disconnected slots.
history.caption: State carbon reporting rules lock in direct fuel and power data while leaving supply chain transport lines optional.
history.title: carbon-report-skipped-transport-lines

style_when: the news is structural and abstract — a stack reordered, a layer added, a flow rerouted — and there is no literal object that carries it, so the idea is stated as a small physical assembly of recognisable parts rather than as bare shapes
prompt: Matte clay 3D render of a modular regulatory reporting assembly resting on a weathered concrete surface. An engineered mechanical block features three securely locked data modules in muted grey polymer and brushed steel. Two designated transport slots remain distinctly empty and bypassed, featuring disconnected brass connector pins. Asymmetric off-centre framing rule with generous negative space. One directional key light raking across the matte surfaces, creating deep contact shadows and highlighting the moulding seams. Muted modern editorial palette, authentic industrial design elements. No text, no bare geometry.
negative_prompt: garbled text, random letters, numbers, UI, watermarks, lettering, printed words
rationale: A clay render allows us to construct the abstract regulatory 'lines' as physical modular slots in an engineered block, highlighting the missing transport data as a structural void.
subject: modular mechanical assembly with two empty transport slots
core_thesis: California's 2026 carbon reporting mandate counts direct fuel and power but leaves supply chain transport lines optional.
core_conflict: Mandated direct reporting vs. omitted outsourced freight data
